source_text: Infantes neque Dei arma neque diaboli gerunt donec peccare possint. Gloria Deo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Infants bear neither God’s arms nor the devil’s until they can sin. Glory to God. Amen.
pass_b_english: Only those who can already sin wear either armor — infants not yet. Glory to God. Amen.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Ps 36–38; do not copy modern FOTC/SC
